name: vuesp.kc868-a2
summary: KinCony KC868-A2 V2.3 controller with 2 relays, 2 opto inputs, 2 OneWire terminals, Ethernet, RS485 Modbus and a GSM socket.
description:
## Vuesp KC868-A2

Firmware 5.0.0 for the KinCony KC868-A2 V2.3. Two relays and two opto-isolated inputs are connected directly to ESP32 GPIO, two independent 1-Wire terminals support DS18B20 sensors, and Ethernet LAN8720A / Wi-Fi plus RS485 Modbus RTU are supported. The SIM800L/SIM7600 socket is documented but not implemented yet.

The project is based on Vuesp 5.x, uses ConfigStore, diagnostics, the current web UI and the Modbus page.
